stem: Meena is sitting inside a bus that is moving along a straight road past a school gate. Which statement about motion and rest is correct?

options.text: Meena is in motion with respect to the book lying on her lap.
Meena is in motion with respect to the school gate.
The school gate is at rest with respect to Meena.
Meena is at rest with respect to everything around her.

teacher.key_rationale: An object is in motion if its position changes with time relative to the chosen reference point. Meena does not move relative to the book beside her (A false), but her position changes relative to the school gate, so B is correct. The gate moves relative to Meena (C false), and D is false because she moves relative to objects outside the bus.
